subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Though Ravi is silent and reserved, he has got __a finger in every pie__.
solution:
The correct answer is:** Involved in many things**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**has got a finger in every pie**" is an idiom that means being involved in many different activities or having a share or interest in various things. (कई अलग-अलग गतिविधियों में शामिल होना या विभिन्न चीजों में हिस्सेदारी या रुचि रखना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Tom is the kind of person who has got a finger in every pie, from cooking to coding.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the segment "has got a finger in every pie" can be substituted with the option "**involved in many things**."
 
• 
 
So, the revised sentence would be: "*Though Ravi is silent and reserved, he is involved in many things.*"

 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

The correct answer is: **exhibited; senseless**.
